Mr. Basketball]] (2007) }} '''Courtney Grant Fortson''' (born May 23, 1988) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]]. ==High school== Fortson attended [[Jefferson Davis High School (Montgomery, Alabama)|Jefferson Davis High School]] in Montgomery, Alabama, where he was named Mr. Basketball by the Alabama Sports Writers Association in 2007.{{cite news |author1=Wesley Lyle |title=Vols' star captures top award - Fortson becomes JD's third "Mr. Basketball" |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/99610393/vols-star-captures-top-award-fortson/ |access-date=April 12, 2022 |work=[[Montgomery Advertiser]] |date=March 23, 2007 |pages=1C, 5C |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}} ==College career== He played his [[college basketball]] at the [[University of Arkansas]] as a guard,{{cite news |author1=Tim Gayle |title=Rivalry holds court |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/99611675/rivalry-holds-court/ |access-date=April 12, 2022 |work=[[The Montgomery Advertiser]] |date=February 13, 2010 |pages=1C, 3C |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}}{{cite news |author1=Ron Higgins |title=Hogs rebound with Fortson |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/99611488/hogs-rebound-with-fortson/ |access-date=April 12, 2022 |work=[[The Commercial Appeal]] |date=February 9, 2010 |page=D2 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}} and recorded the school's second-ever [[triple double]] (20 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds) in a December 2008 win over [[North Carolina Central University]]."[https://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/sec/2008-12-11-arkansas-fortson_N.htm Fortson nets triple-double as Arkansas races past N.C. Central]". ''USA Today''. December 11, 2008. Retrieved on January 24, 2012. ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the 2010 NBA draft, Fortson signed with [[CSA Steaua București (Basketball)|Steaua Turabo Bucuresti]] of Romania but later left in January 2011. In March 2011, he joined the Reno Bighorns of the NBA D-League. In November 2011, Fortson was acquired by the [[Los Angeles D-Fenders]]. But on December 8, 2011, he was signed by the [[Los Angeles Clippers]]. However, he was later waived before the start of the 2011–12 season and re-joined the D-Fenders. Not long after being waived by the Clippers, he was called up on January 16, 2012, on a ten-day contract."[http://www.rgj.com/article/20120117/SPORTS10/201170312/Former-Bighorn-Fortson-signs-Clippers Former Bighorn Fortson signs with Clippers]". ''Reno Gazette Journal''. January 16, 2012. Retrieved on January 24, 2012. However, he was waived by the team on January 27, 2012, after playing four games.{{Cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=9157 |title=Clippers waive guard Courtney Fortson |access-date=October 10, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131213141634/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=9157 |archive-date=December 13, 2013 |url-status=dead }}"[https://www.espn.com/blog/los-angeles/clippers/post/_/id/389/clippers-waive-courtney-fortson Clippers waive Courtney Fortson]". ESPN. January 27, 2012. Retrieved on January 28, 2012. Fortson signed a ten-day contract with the [[Houston Rockets]] later that season, and was eventually signed by the Rockets for the remainder of the season.{{Cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=9463 |title=Rockets sign Courtney Fortson to 10-day contract |access-date=March 18, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120403171458/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=9463 |archive-date=April 3, 2012 |url-status=dead }}{{cite news |author1=Cortez Strickland |title=Montgomery native Fortson fought hard for shot in NBA |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/99610978/montgomery-native-fortson-fought-hard/ |access-date=April 12, 2022 |work=[[Montgomery Advertiser]] |date=April 25, 2012 |page=1D |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{open access}}[http://www.chron.com/sports/rockets/article/Rockets-summary-Forston-signed-for-rest-of-season-3439676.php Rockets summary: Forston signed for rest of season] In September 2012, he was waived by the Rockets.[http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-add-fogg-and-mccamey Rockets Add Fogg and McCamey] Fortson, again, signed with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] for training camp on September 29, 2012, but on October 7, 2012, he and Chris Johnson were waived by the Clippers.{{Cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=11096 |title=Clippers waive Courtney Fortson and Chris Johnson |access-date=October 10, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131213141636/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=11096 |archive-date=December 13, 2013 |url-status=dead }} Later that month, he joined the Los Angeles D-Fenders. On February 4, 2013, Fortson was named to the Futures All-Star roster for the 2013 NBA D-League All-Star Game.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/2013_nba_development_league_all_star_rosters_announced_2013_02_04.html 2013 NBA Development League All-Star Game Rosters Announced] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131022065410/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/2013_nba_development_league_all_star_rosters_announced_2013_02_04.html |date=October 22, 2013 }} In September 2013, he signed with [[BC Avtodor Saratov|Avtodor Saratov]] of Russia for the 2013–14 season.{{cite news|title=Avtodor Saratov sign Courtney Fortson and Gleb Plotnikov|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/russia/62708/avtodor-saratov-sign-courtney-fortson-and-gleb-plotnikov.html|accessdate=October 10, 2013|work=Sportando.com|date=September 4, 2013}} On June 3, 2014, he signed with Trotamundos de Carabobo for the rest of the 2014 [[Liga Profesional de Baloncesto|LPB]] season.{{cite news|title=Trotamundos de Carabobo announce Courtney Fortson|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/121676/trotamundos-de-carabobo-announce-courtney-fortson.html|accessdate=June 3, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=June 3, 2014}} On July 5, 2014, he returned to Avtodor Saratov, signing for one more season.{{cite news|title=Courtney Fortson and Anton Glazunov sign with Avtodor|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/125853/courtney-fortson-and-anton-glazunov-sign-with-avtodor.html|accessdate=July 23, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=July 5, 2014}} On February 18, 2015, Fortson scored a [[triple double]] in a [[EuroChallenge]]-game against [[Güssing Knights]]; he recorded 30 points, 12 rebounds and 13 assists and was named Weekly MVP.[http://www.fibaeurope.com/eurochallenge/coid_dG00eARIGN22YEWhzgnJ23.articleMode_on.html Fortson Is Last 16 Week 5 Top Performer] On July 11, 2015, Fortson signed with the Turkish club [[Banvit B.K.|Banvit]].{{cite news|title=Courtney Fortson officially signs with Banvit|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/168308/courtney-fortson-officially-signs-with-banvit.html|accessdate=July League|BSL]].{{cite news|title=Courtney Fortson, Banvit part ways|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/193528/courtney-fortson-banvit-part-ways.html|accessdate=March 9, 2016|work=Sportando.com|date=March 9, 2016}} In July 2016, Forston signed with Chinese club [[Zhejiang Lions]] for the 2016–17 CBA season.{{cite news|title=CBA Team Zhejiang Guangsha Lions Signs Former NBA Player Courtney Fortson|url=http://www.chinatopix.com/articles/96269/20160724/basketball-news-cba-team-zhejiang-guangsha-lions-signs-former-nba-player-courtney-fortson.htm|accessdate=September 14, 2016|work=chinatopix.com|date=July 24, 2016}} On January 4, 2017, Fortson recorded a triple-double after posting 22 points, 11 rebounds and a career-high 20 assists in a 117–130 loss to the [[Shandong Heroes|Shandong Golden Stars]].{{cite web|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/boxScores/China/2017/0104_1946_7304.asp|title=Shandong Golden Stars 130 – Guangsha Lions 117|publisher=EuroBasket|date=January 4, 2017|accessdate=May 1, 2020}} Fortson was named the [[CBA MVP]] for the 2017–18 season, after he averaged 31.1 points, 12 assists and 7.8 rebounds per game while leading Zhejiang to the first seed in the CBA. {{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/asia/china/266280/courtney-fortson-named-cba-mvp-of-the-season.html|title=Courtney Fortson named CBA MVP of the season|date=February 28, 2018|publisher=Sportando.basketball}}{{Dead link|date=July 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} On July 26, 2021, Fortson signed with [[Bnei Herzliya]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].{{cite news |title=Courtney Fortson joins Bnei Herzliya |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/courtney-fortson-joins-bnei-herzliya/ |website=Sportando |access-date=July 27, 2021 2024, Fortson joined [[Denain Voltaire Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro B]].{{cite news |title=DENAIN VOLTAIRE TIENT SON MENEUR |url=https://www.denainvoltairehainaut-basket.fr/wp2016/denain-voltaire-tient-son-meneur/ |access-date=May 31, 2024 |publisher=Denain Voltaire Basketball |date=February 23, 2024}} On May 23, 2024, Fortson joined [[Changsha Wantian Yongsheng]] of the [[National Basketball League (China)|National Basketball League]].{{cite news |author=赵紫名 |title=勇胜“小外援”驾到，前CBA助攻王福特森加盟 |url=https://www.icswb.com/h/153/20240523/871694.html |access-date=May 31, 2024 |work=长沙晚报掌上长沙 |date=May 23, 2024}} On December 26, 2024, Fortson signed with the [[Homenetmen Beirut
